scope: Skill source classification and risk presentation

checks.evidence: UNSAFE renders as Unverified / 未验证 in cards, search and the edit form.
Risk is Not assessed when there is no attached assessment evidence.
One source badge on the card; a separately labelled Source and risk section in the detail drawer.
Source marker, source verification and risk assessment have separate labelled rows.
Neutral shared theme tokens replace red danger and green verification cues.
English and Simplified Chinese browser paths verified; all three locales pass structural parity tests.
checks.deduction: No new full zoom or assistive-technology acceptance run.

checks.evidence: A typed presentation adapter keeps legacy source markers separate from verification and risk evidence.
Built-in and Marked trusted detail drawers do not claim recorded verification or passing scans. Four regression cases cover the evidence boundary.
Searching 未验证 returns the Code Generation card; its source and risk drawer opens successfully.
Changing the source selector to TRUSTED_SOURCE in an unsaved form leaves Risk assessment: Not assessed; cancel restores the catalog without a resource write.
Existing card geometry, typography, icons and neutral semantic tokens retained.
No extra card risk badge or alarm styling for an unverified source.

notes: Historical UNSAFE values remain compatible; their user-facing label is Unverified / 未验证.
No security scanner or source-verification workflow was added. Without evidence, the UI reports no verification record and no risk assessment.
Unsaved language changes used for browser review were restored to the original en-US preference.
